label: Generate / Regenerate Image
description: Generates a previsualization image for a shot element using AI image generation.

characters.description: Only include characters whose names appear in the shot description text

locations.description: Include the location if it is referenced in the shot via a set-in binding

referenceInstruction: Using the attached reference images as visual guides for character appearance and location setting. The characters in this frame must match these references exactly — same face, hair, body type, clothing, and features. The environment should be consistent with the location reference.

sections.template: Shot on a cinema camera{lensDesc ? ' with a ' + lensDesc : ''}. {movementDesc ? 'Camera technique: ' + movementDesc + '. ' : ''}{composition ? composition + '. ' : ''}

Style: Cinematic previsualization frame, shot on 35mm film with subtle grain. Professional cinematography with rich color grading, deep shadows, and controlled highlights. The image should feel like a single frame from a feature film.

frameSizeLensMap.WIDE: wide-angle lens (24mm), deep depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.EXTREME WIDE: ultra wide-angle lens (16mm), expansive depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.MEDIUM: standard lens (50mm), natural perspective with moderate depth of field
frameSizeLensMap.MEDIUM CLOSE-UP: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field (f/2.8)
frameSizeLensMap.CLOSE-UP: 85mm portrait lens, very shallow depth of field (f/1.8)
frameSizeLensMap.EXTREME CLOSE-UP: macro lens (100mm), extremely shallow depth of field (f/1.4)

cameraMovementMap.STATIC: locked-off camera on a tripod, perfectly still frame
cameraMovementMap.PAN: smooth horizontal pan following the action
cameraMovementMap.TILT: gentle vertical tilt revealing the scene
cameraMovementMap.DOLLY: dolly tracking shot moving through the space
cameraMovementMap.SLOW PUSH IN: subtle dolly push-in, gradually tightening the frame
cameraMovementMap.PULL BACK: slow dolly pull-back revealing the wider scene
cameraMovementMap.TRACKING: tracking shot moving alongside the subject
cameraMovementMap.CRANE: crane shot with elevated, sweeping perspective
cameraMovementMap.HANDHELD: handheld camera with slight organic movement
cameraMovementMap.STEADICAM: smooth Steadicam floating through the scene
